piezas.titulo: Production practice: Humour, idioms and cultural references
texto: Integrated conversation: taking part in a literary translation colloquium on adapting idioms and wordplay. At Distinguished level you are assessed on your ability to explain complex cultural analogies to foreign listeners, to propose functional equivalents in Spanish that keep the wit of the original, and to debate without pedantry the identity value of traditional expressions. Use expressions such as «การเทียบเคียงความหมาย» (the functional equivalence of meaning) and «เสน่ห์ของภาษา» (the expressive richness and charm of the language).
